sourceTitle: An Easy Brandy-Spiked Chicken Liver Pâté Recipe
sourceText:
An Easy Brandy-Spiked Chicken Liver Pâté Recipe
By: Sheri Wetherell
Published: Thursday, December 5, 2019 - 2:59pm

Ingredients




1 pound chicken livers
1 small yellow onion, sliced
Olive oil
1/4 cup brandy
1/4 cup heavy cream
A good quality flake salt or sel gris (gray salt) for garnish

Preparation

1 Heat about one tablespoon of olive oil in a skillet and cook onions until soft. Add chicken livers and sauté until cooked through, about 5 minutes. 2 Add brandy and simmer until alcohol has cooked off. Toss into a blender and blend on high. Periodically stop the blender and push down larger pieces with a wooden spoon to incorporate. Add cream and continue to blend until smooth. 3 Place a mesh sieve over a bowl. Transfer mixture to the sieve and press through with a silicone spatula to remove any unsmooth pieces. 4 Spoon pâté into one serving bowl or a few small ones, and smooth out the top. 5 Cover with plastic wrap and chill for at least 20 minutes. 6 Garnish with a sprinkle of sel gris or other fine salt. 7 Excellent served with cornichon, Dijon mustard and a grainy mustard on the side.
